THE CLARK COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE IS ACCEPTING APPLICATIONS FOR
FULLTIME POLICE OFFICER. THE HOURLY WAGE IS COMPETITIVE AND BENEFITS
INCLUDE INSURANCE AND RETIREMENT. APPLICANTS MUST MEET THE
FOLLOWING CRITERIA:
I. MUST BE A CITIZEN OF THE UNITED STATES
2. HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATE, OR GED EQUIVALENT, OR HAVE
COMPLETED 1S ACADEMIC COLLEGE CREDITS
3. TWO OR MORE YEARS OF RESPONSIBLE WORK EXPERIENCE
FOLLOWING HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION
4. FINGERPRINT CLEARANCE BY THE IDAHO STATE POLICE/BCI AND
THE FBI. ACONVICTION OR WITHHELD JUDGMENT FOR ANY LOCAL, STATE, OR
FEDERAL CRIME MAY BE GROUNDS FOR REJECTION.
5. VALID DRIVERS LICENSE FROM THE STATE OF RESIDENCE WITH NO
RECORD OF HABITUAL VIOLATIONS (FIVE OR MORE) DURING THE THREE YEARS
IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING APPLICATION TO THE SHERIFF'S OFFICE. NO RECORD
OF SUSPENSION, DUI CONVICTION, OR WITHHELD JUDGMENT DURING THE TWO
YEARS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING APPLICATION TO THE SHERIFF'S OFFICE.
6. PASS A MEDICAL EXAMINATION BY A LICENSED PHYSICIAN
7. MEET OR EXCEED THE POST VISION AND HEARING STANDARDS
8. PASS THE POST PHYSICAL FITNESS TEST
9. MUST BE ABLE TO PASS A POLYGRAPH AND PSYCHOLOGICAL TEST
ALL APPLICATIONS CAN BE PICKED UP AT THE CLARK COUNTY SHERIFFS OFFICE
AT ANY TIME. APPLICATIONS WILL BE ACCEPTED UNTIL DECEMBER 23rd, 201] AT
5:00 P.M
SHERIFF BART MAY
CLARK COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE
224 WEST MAIN STREET
DUBOIS, IDAHO 83423
